item.title: Osman Hadi laid to rest beside national poet Kazi Nazrul
item.description: Dhaka – Sharif Osman Hadi, spokesman for the Inqilab Manch cultural group, was buried beside the grave of Bangladesh’s national poet, Kazi Nazrul Islam, on Saturday. item.title: Tarique Rahman returns home after 17 years in exile
item.description: Dhaka – Tarique Rahman, the acting chairman of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), returned to Bangladesh on Thursday, ending 17 years of exile in London. A Biman Bangladesh Airlines flight carrying Rahman, his wife Zubaida Rahman, daughter Zaima Zarnaz Rahman, and other members of his entourage landed at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport at 11:40 AM. item.title: Tarique Rahman speaks with Chief Adviser Yunus upon return to Bangladesh
item.description: Dhaka – On his arrival in Dhaka from London, Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) Acting Chairman Tarique Rahman spoke by phone with Chief Adviser Muhammad Yunus, party officials said on Thursday. Mr. Rahman made the call from the lobby of Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport. He was returning home after 17 years of exile in the United Kingdom. […]

item.title: Tourists flock to Kuakata beach for Christmas holidays
item.description: Barishal – Hundreds of tourists have arrived in the coastal town of Kuakata, on the shores of the Bay of Bengal, to enjoy a long Christmas weekend. item.description: Mymensingh – The state-run election awareness campaign ‘Vote-er Gari’ (Vote Car) has launched in the northern city of Mymensingh, featuring patriotic songs performed by young artists and electoral campaign videos displayed on LED screens. item.title: Justice Zubayer Rahman Chowdhury sworn in as Bangladesh’s 26th Chief Justice
item.description: Dhaka – Justice Zubayer Rahman Chowdhury was sworn in as the Chief Justice of Bangladesh on Sunday. President Mohammed Shahabuddin administered the oath of office at a ceremony in the Durbar Hall of the presidential palace, Bangabhaban. item.title: Deadline for tax return submission extended again
item.description: Dhaka – The government has extended the deadline for submitting income tax returns for the 2025-26 fiscal year by an additional month for individual taxpayers and Hindu undivided families.
